definition: Minimum size of a pairwise-intersecting 6-uniform family with transversal number 6.

scope_note: The 16-card lower bound is computer-assisted. DRAT checks certify the UNSAT conclusions for the generated CNFs; correctness and completeness of the mathematical reduction and CNF encoding remain part of the trusted proof layer and must be audited in the source code and proof text.
